$comment: ss#2320. The overlay's ACCEPTED_ACTION_TYPES, snapshotted at the overlay commit a customer Machine actually ships. WHY THIS FILE EXISTS: the runtime validates rows against the OVERLAY's constant, the portal renders from THIS repo's constant, and nothing pinned the two together. shared/audit_contract.py performs no validation at all (agent_event_params + a raw INSERT accepts any string), so the path 'overlay adds an emitter -> declares it overlay-side -> overlay CI passes -> rows land in client ledgers -> portal renders nothing' had no gate anywhere on it. A type the overlay knows and this repo does not is invisible on the client feed and indistinguishable from a deliberate suppression. HOW TO MAINTAIN: when OVERLAY_REF moves in operator/templates/Dockerfile, re-extract overlayTypes from plugins/hermes-smd-audit/schemas.py at the new ref and update overlayRef here in the same PR. tests/audit-vocabulary-parity.test.ts fails when the two refs disagree, so a bump cannot silently skip the refresh.
overlayOnlyNote: Declared by the overlay, absent from this repo's AUDIT_ACTION_TYPES. Each needs a reason, because an overlay-only type that ever gains an emitter writes rows the portal renders as nothing. None of these has an emitter at the pinned ref (they appear only in the declaration), which is why they are tolerated rather than fixed. 2026-08-18 re-stamp 20518e86 -> 0716dc17: compare API shows zero action_type deltas in the range (only hermes-smd-reply internals, matter_binding, docs, tests); vocabulary re-derivation is the identity.

consoleOnlyNote: Declared here, absent from the overlay vocabulary. These are written by CONSOLE-side producers (the decommission pipeline, the wake path, the customer.yaml sync, the admin console), never by the seat runtime, so the overlay has no reason to know them. Harmless in the direction that matters: a console-written row is already rendered from this repo's own vocabulary.
